instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: JourneyQuill Document Readiness tracks travel documents before a booking is considered ready. Travelers submit booking requests with destination and intended travel date, upload available documents, and mark required documents expected later. Travel Advisors record required document categories, Document Reviewers accept or reject submissions and add rejection reasons, and Booking Coordinators mark bookings document-ready only after all required documents are accepted. The category list and acceptance criteria remain unresolved; ticket issuance and visa application submission are excluded.

output.summary: JourneyQuill Document Readiness tracks required travel documents and controls when a booking is considered document-ready. Travelers provide booking details and documents, Travel Advisors record required document categories, Document Reviewers record acceptance or rejection decisions and reasons, and Booking Coordinators apply the all-documents-accepted readiness rule. The category list and acceptance criteria remain unresolved, while ticket issuance and visa application submission are excluded.
output.primary_goal: Track required travel documents and determine when a booking is document-ready.
key_capabilities: Submit booking requests with destination and intended travel date.
Upload available documents and mark required documents expected later.
Accept or reject submitted documents and add rejection reasons.
Mark a booking document-ready only after every required document is accepted.
unresolved_points: The available required-document categories are not agreed.
The acceptance criteria for submitted documents are not finalized.
